text:
alex wang: quick heads-up — I ran a quick bring-up of ember-12b on the tiny bench, want to prioritize this for dedicated quant experiments? :eyes:

rachel chen: short summary plz — perf / cost / any regressions so far?

alex wang: perf looks promising on fp16. baseline generation p95 latency ~240ms on p3dn (seq=512). quant-8/8 run on A100-nvlink gives ~1.9x throughput improvement but some flakiness in exact-match on the NLU suite.

samir patel: can you paste the perf snippet?

alex wang: ```
# quick perf notes
model: ember-12b fp16
hw: p3dn.24xlarge
seq: 512
throughput: 220 tok/s
p95: 240ms

model: ember-12b int8 (per-channel)
hw: a100-80gb
throughput: 420 tok/s
p95: 130ms
issues: EM drop ~1.8 pts on intent accuracy
```

maria lopez: ok the EM drop is concerning. is it consistent across prompts or a particular dataset?

alex wang: looks concentrated on low-context prompts (customer support short queries). longer context evals (docs QA) are within noise.

joshua kim: thanks — can we attach a quick prioritization score? product wants low-regressions on short prompts.

rachel chen: proposal: score on 4 axes (0-5): quality_risk, perf_gain, infra_effort, customer_impact. add comments.

samir patel: I started a tiny rubric earlier. example: quality_risk=3, perf_gain=4, infra_effort=2, customer_impact=3 -> total=12.

alex wang: applying quickly for ember-12b: quality_risk=3, perf_gain=4, infra_effort=2, customer_impact=3. comments: good latency win with int8, targeted regression on short prompts but possible to mitigate with selective fallback.

maria lopez: +1 for experimenting but prefer a canary plan first. suggested rollout: canary on Dedicated small pool + automatic fallback to fp16 if quality metric drops >1.0 EM.

joshua kim: agree. add ops checklist: update model-variants, add fallback routing policy, create an alert tied to eval-set short-prompts.

triage-bot: New intake created: /intake ember-12b quant-experiments (link: https://redwood.internal/intake/ember-12b). Assigned: alex wang, samir patel.

rachel chen: can we schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to lock the rollout plan? I'm available 10:00-11:30 PT.

alex wang: booked 10:30 PT. I'll bring the initial eval dashboards and a quick canary run script.

samir patel: prep tasks before the sync:
- add short-prompts eval to nightly
- run int8 with KV cache behavior toggled (on/off)
- estimate cost delta for Dedicated small pool

maria lopez: on the short-prompts eval: please include conversion-rate sim (toy web UI) — product cares about downstream ux.

alex wang: noted. pinging @rachel chen for product acceptance criteria doc link: https://docs.redwood/ember-12b/acceptance (draft).

joshua kim: one more ops note: quant int8 requires compiling a separate kernel on Dedicated GPUs; add an angela-job to warm the cache pre-rollout. Also quota check for burst capacity.

samir patel: I'll run the initial int8 vs fp16 A/B with 10k prompt pairs overnight and post the diff here.

alex wang: perfect. if regressions >1.5 EM we'll abort the canary per policy. otherwise proceed to 10% traffic for 24h then escalate. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

rachel chen: perfect. thanks team, see you 10:30 PT. :rocket:

alex wang: (after meeting) quick notes: consensus to proceed with focused quant experiments, prioritize mitigations for short prompts, Samir to run overnight eval, Maria to own UX sim, Josh to prepare ops checklist. I'll update the intake with tasks and expected timeline (~1 week).

triage-bot: Intake updated: status=triage -> in_progress. checklist added to https://redwood.internal/intake/ember-12b/checklist

samir patel: posted preliminary results: int8 overall +42% throughput, EM diff -1.9 on short-prompts, -0.2 overall. attaching CSV in the intake.

maria lopez: reviewing CSV, looks like certain token patterns (greetings + short suffix) trigger the worst diffs. filing a prompt set to use as a targeted eval.

joshua kim: ops note: prepared canary config and fallback rule, tested in staging. no infra blockers.

alex wang: thanks — moving to runbook and scheduling canary next Tue. will ping when traffic flip is ready.

rachel chen: thanks all. closing thread for now, keep updates in the intake page. :thumbsup:
